design.authority: Evidence & Audit read-model only: creates no new truth, writes nothing (no file, journal entry, audit event or state).
design.kinds: WORK_RUN_STEP (Work OS journal RUN_EVIDENCE and RUN_CHECKPOINT entries), WORK_RUN_LOG (run evidence log files under runs/<runId>/), REVIEW_EVIDENCE (<dir of orchestrator-policy roots.stateFile>/evidence/*.json), AUDIT_CHECKPOINT (audit/checkpoints/*.json).
design.evidenceId: evi_ + first 32 hex of sha256(JSON [kind, repo- or data-dir-relative path, locator or store evidence id, recorded hash or null]); derived from the recorded hash, so a tampered file keeps its id and shows MISMATCH.

verificationBasis.WORK_RUN_STEP: journal entry hash recomputed with the store's own canonical sha256 over the entry body; chain integrity stays owned by WorkOsStore (tampered or unavailable store marks the source ERROR, counts null)
verificationBasis.WORK_RUN_LOG: sha256 of the file bytes recomputed (streamed) and compared with the recorded logSha256; null logSha256 gives UNVERIFIABLE NO_RECORDED_HASH
verificationBasis.REVIEW_EVIDENCE: recorded reviewResultSha256 compared with sha256 of the embedded reviewResultText bytes, plus bundleDigest equals frozenBundle.bundleDigest; the whole-file sha256 is reported but the file as a whole has no recorded hash
verificationBasis.AUDIT_CHECKPOINT: working-tree bytes hashed as a git blob id (sha1 over 'blob <size>' + NUL byte+bytes, streamed) and compared with the git HEAD blob id; untracked file gives UNVERIFIABLE NOT_COMMITTED, tracked but deleted gives MISSING

design.bounds: limit 1..100 (default 50), opaque cursor over a total sort key, hash cap 64 MiB (larger gives UNVERIFIABLE FILE_TOO_LARGE_TO_HASH), JSON parse cap 16 MiB, at most 10000 directory entries per source, tail at most 4096 bytes.
design.pathSafety: relative ids only, no '..', no backslash or drive letter, no absolute paths, Work OS log paths must start with runs/<runId>/, lstat + realpath containment in the allowed root, non-regular files rejected; rejected entries are listed with source.path null and are never read; source directories whose realpath leaves the repo give source state ERROR.
design.tail: WORK_RUN_LOG detail returns at most 4 KB, redacted with core/workos/secret-scan redactSecrets (read with 512 byte lookback so a token cut by the window start is still matched) and scrubbed of known root and user-directory absolute paths; withheld when verification is MISMATCH or MISSING.
design.visibility: Work OS evidence uses the server tenant scope; repository-level evidence is returned only when the server actor is FOUNDER_LOCAL and only for queries without missionId/runId.
design.cockpit: new optional block evidence{state,total,verified,mismatch,missing,unverifiable,sources}; state VERIFIED when at least one queried source is available and none errored, UNAVAILABLE when none is available (counts null), ERROR when any source errors (counts null).
